en.text: You must take care not to break it.

original: また壊しやがって！

en.text: You broke it again!

original: また壊したな！

en.text: You broke it again!

original: 次壊したら、直さないからね。

en.text: If you break it again, I'm not going to fix it.

original: 次壊したら、直さないからな。

en.text: If you break it again, I'm not fixing it.

original: そなんに無理しなくてもいいんじゃない？ちゃんと休まないと、体を壊しちゃうよ。

en.text: You don't have to push yourself so hard, you know? If you don't rest properly, you'll end up harming your health.
